producer_report.summary: Planning stops at the round cap are now resumable. When a job fails with "the plan still needed revising in the last round", `athena retry` seeds the retry's planning round 1 with the kept round-3 plan plus every finding, so round 1 is the single revision, and the first critic call reviews the revised plan. Other stops still plan fresh. Kept data are the existing job-plan-3 and critique-3 records; JobPlan gains an optional `resumed_from`, skipped when none and defaulted for old records. `athena status` now prints planning rounds and planner+critic cost per landed job as chain totals over `retried_job` predecessors, with the landed job's own figures beside them, split before/after at the first job whose plan has `resumed_from`, with counts, cutover job and time, and the label "since the first resumed planning". Tests: lifecycle integration tests (cap resume; fresh plan after reject, timeout, failed verification), reading.rs seed unit tests (incl. verbatim pre-change cap outcome text), status.rs planning_cost tests, a display.rs render test, a records.rs round-trip test, and a briefs.rs wording test. CHANGELOG has an Unreleased entry.

criteria_check.criterion: A test stops a job at the planning cap with a fixture critic. `athena retry` of it gives the planner the kept round-3 plan and the critic's findings. The first critic round of the retry sees the revised plan, and the retry does only one revision round before the critic. Run: cargo test --locked (named test).
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle planning passed (a_retry_of_a_job_stopped_at_the_planning_cap_resumes_from_the_kept_plan). It asserts calls after the retry reader are Planner, Critic, Producer; planner brief 4 holds the kept approach and both round-3 findings and none of rounds 1-2; critic brief 4 holds the revised approach and not the kept one; exactly 4 planner and 4 critic calls.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows a retry of a job that stopped for any other reason (e.g. timeout, verification failure) still starts the planner with a fresh plan and receives no kept plan. Run: cargo test --locked.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle any_other_reason passed (a_retry_of_a_job_that_stopped_for_any_other_reason_plans_fresh): reject, timeout and failed-verification cases each have no '## Revision' and no kept text in the retry's planner brief, and job-plan-1 has no resumed_from. Unit test a_stop_for_any_other_reason_or_a_new_request_gives_no_seed in reading.rs also passed.

criteria_check.criterion: athena status prints planning rounds and planning cost per landed job, computed from job records. A test with fixture records asserts the printed numbers, including a before/after split. Run: cargo test --locked.
criteria_check.evidence: status.rs planning_cost_tests (4 tests, passed) assert chain-total and own mean rounds and cost for before and after groups from hand-built records, a three-job chain with a cycle, an empty after group, and absence when no planned job landed. display.rs planning_cost_lines_show_both_groups_the_cutover_and_the_measured_numbers (passed) asserts the printed text and numbers. The status() function wires planning_cost into StatusView and display::status prints it.

open_issues: Two test-fixture literals outside the listed deliverables were edited (one line each): store.rs plan() and admission.rs findings_for_path, both adding `resumed_from: None`, as the plan allowed; the new field breaks those literals otherwise.
A landed job with no recorded dispatch time counts as 'before' in the status split (plan assumption).
FirstRoundCounts is unchanged; for a resumed job round 1 is the revision round, noted in the CHANGELOG.
docs/records.md was not edited (outside the deliverables); the field is documented by its rustdoc and the CHANGELOG.
mistakes: The first clippy run failed with clippy::type_complexity on a lifecycle.rs test helper return type; fixed with a Briefs type alias.
learnings: Scenario's scripted plans and critiques are indexed by global call number across jobs, so a retry's calls continue after the first job's.
`athena.retry` returns (Proposal, bool); `go` on the new job runs the planning loop.
Closing a job stopped at the cap already commits job-plan-N and critique-N for every round, so no new record type was needed.
Bash refuses tail and Grep refuses paths outside the working directory, so large saved command output cannot be searched.
desires: A way to read the saved output of a large cargo test run to confirm the full-suite result directly.
